title: Fuel-cell ORR cathode reference family
objective: Optional literature-backed electrocatalyst family for PEM fuel-cell cathode screening. These routes are reference starting points for ORR catalyst cost, route maturity, and evidence quality, not hard product boundaries.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance economics, source confidence, route confidence, and performance.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward current catalyst cost while preserving route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward stronger literature confidence and better route reproducibility.

citations.label: Nature 2012
citations.note: Seminal benchmark review on electrocatalyst routes and cost/performance constraints for automotive fuel cells.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2021
citations.note: High-level review of PEMFC cathode catalyst and cathode-layer design tradeoffs, useful as a route-framing reference for Pt and PGM-free baselines.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2021
citations.note: Oxygen-permeable ionomer study directly tying cathode-layer ionomer chemistry to PEMFC power-density and poisoning behavior.

citations.label: Nature Catalysis 2019
citations.note: Dense-active-site Fe-N-C cathode route meeting early PEMFC PGM-free activity targets.

citations.label: Nature Energy 2022
citations.note: Durable Fe-N-C route with nitrogen-carbon coating and long steady-state PEMFC operation.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2024
citations.note: Monosymmetric Fe-N4 site engineering for durable PEMFC cathodes.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2024
citations.note: Trace-bromide Fe-NC electrocatalyst reaching high PEMFC power density at low PGM-free cost basis.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2022
citations.note: Iron atom-cluster interactions that improve both activity and durability in Fe-N-C PEMFC cathodes.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2025
citations.note: Pt intermetallic alloy route with improved ORR durability through quasi-covalent bond-network regulation.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2025
citations.note: Anti-dissolution Pt/Co interfacial design for durable PEMFC cathode catalysts.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2025
citations.note: Support and ionomer-distribution engineering showing how carbon support treatment materially changes PEMFC cathode utilization.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2025
citations.note: Intermetallic Pt3Fe and ionomer-sandwich architecture that directly targets ionomer poisoning and transport losses in PEMFC cathodes.

citations.label: Fuel Cell Store XT 20% Pt/C
citations.note: Public Pt/C powder quote used as a transparent vendor-lab procurement anchor.

citations.label: Sigma-Aldrich 239267
citations.note: Public cobalt nitrate quote used as a transparent precursor anchor for Pt-Co route screening.

citations.label: Nano Letters 2013
citations.note: 9 nm Pt-Ni octahedra with clean {111} facets: record 3.3 A/mgPt mass activity at 0.9 V.

citations.label: Science 2014
citations.note: Pt3Ni nanoframes with Pt-skin surfaces: 36x mass activity over commercial Pt/C.

citations.label: Science 2007
citations.note: The Pt3Ni(111) surface origin of the ORR activity gain.

catalog_quotes.material: XT 20% Platinum on Vulcan XC-72R Grade S
catalog_quotes.note: Public lab-scale Pt/C anchor. Commercial screening in COMET still follows live Pt feed plus route assumptions.
Transparent precursor anchor for Co-containing cathode routes.

route_templates.name: PFSA Pt/C CCM cathode route
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: Commercial Pt/C ink to CCM route
preprocess: Carbon support wetting and PFSA staging
quality_gates: MEA resistance and H2-air polarization check
route_templates.route_note: Closest route to commercial PEMFC cathode manufacturing and the most defensible baseline for price screening.

route_templates.name: Pt-Co alloy cathode route
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: Alloyed Pt-Co cathode with post-alloy conditioning
preprocess: Support pre-wet and slurry solids check
route_templates.route_note: Higher-performing PEMFC cathode route, but alloy ordering, Co retention, and post-treatment discipline add route overhead.

route_templates.name: Fe-N-C PGM-free cathode route
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: Pyrolyzed Fe-N-C cathode with CCM finishing
synthesis: Ionomer ink homogenization and CCM coating
route_templates.route_note: Best noble-metal avoidance route in the family, but pyrolysis, acid wash, and durability control keep the route less mature than Pt-based baselines.

candidates.title: Pt/C baseline cathode
candidates.summary: Commercial Pt/C PEMFC cathode baseline used as the benchmark cost anchor.
decision_notes: Most transferable PEMFC cathode basis and the clearest commercial comparison point.
Economics remain dominated by live Pt price exposure even when route maturity is high.

pricing.note: Live Pt feed with a mild precursor/conversion markup for commercial Pt/C screening.

Carbon support retained on an engineering proxy basis while catalog Pt/C powder quotes remain visible as anchors. Bracketed by public references: UN Comtrade 2024 U.S. carbon-black import unit value ~$1.88/kg (~$0.85/lb rubber grade) and Fuel Cell Store Vulcan XC-72R lab retail ~$950/kg. Bulk conductive/acetylene battery grades cluster at $5,000-7,000/t in marketplace offers (MOQ 1-2 t), the tier between rubber grade and lab retail.

candidates.title: Pt-Co intermetallic cathode
candidates.summary: Pt-alloy route that trades extra route discipline for stronger ORR activity and Pt utilization.
decision_notes: Best fit when PEMFC cathode performance is worth extra alloying and transition-metal retention discipline.
Still expensive because Pt remains the dominant cost driver, but the route can justify higher utilization targets.

pricing.note: Live Pt feed for Pt-Co alloy cathode screening.
Live Co feed with precursor markup to represent ordered Pt-Co cathode manufacture.

Carbon support kept on an engineering basis to avoid vendor-lab distortion in the support term. Bracketed by public references: UN Comtrade 2024 U.S. carbon-black import unit value ~$1.88/kg (~$0.85/lb rubber grade) and Fuel Cell Store Vulcan XC-72R lab retail ~$950/kg. Bulk conductive/acetylene battery grades cluster at $5,000-7,000/t in marketplace offers (MOQ 1-2 t), the tier between rubber grade and lab retail.

candidates.title: Fe-N-C PGM-free cathode
candidates.summary: PGM-free PEMFC cathode route that chases ORR activity through Fe-N-C site engineering rather than Pt loading.
decision_notes: The strongest noble-metal-avoidance route in this family, but durability and process reproducibility still lag Pt-based cathodes.
Economics are attractive because metal exposure is low, yet route complexity is dominated by pyrolysis and post-treatment control.

pricing.note: Live Fe feed with precursor markup as a simple cost anchor for Fe-N-C manufacture.

Carbon host and nitrogen-source costs are grouped into a conservative proxy while the route premium captures pyrolysis and acid-wash overhead. Bracketed by public references: UN Comtrade 2024 U.S. carbon-black import unit value ~$1.88/kg (~$0.85/lb rubber grade) and Fuel Cell Store Vulcan XC-72R lab retail ~$950/kg. Bulk conductive/acetylene battery grades cluster at $5,000-7,000/t in marketplace offers (MOQ 1-2 t), the tier between rubber grade and lab retail.

candidates.title: PtNi octahedra (mass-activity ceiling)
candidates.summary: Shape-controlled platinum-nickel octahedra put the family's platinum-thrifting ceiling on record at 3.3 A/mgPt - an order of magnitude over Pt/C - bought with solvothermal synthesis discipline.
decision_notes: Screens the upper bound of Pt-mass reduction between the Pt/C baseline, the PtCo intermetallic and the PGM-free entry.
Solvothermal shape control (W(CO)6-steered growth, surfactant stripping) is the readiness discount; the material bill itself is ordinary.

pricing.note: Live Pt feed with an elevated markup for the solvothermal shape-controlled route.
Alloying nickel on a contained-metal basis.

Carbon-black dispersal support for the shaped alloy particles. Bracketed by UN Comtrade rubber-grade carbon black (~$0.85/lb), conductive/acetylene bulk offers ($5,000-7,000/t) and lab retail (~$950/kg).
